text.arabic_uthmani: أَفَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَتَكُونَ لَهُمْ قُلُوبٌۭ يَعْقِلُونَ بِهَآ أَوْ ءَاذَانٌۭ يَسْمَعُونَ بِهَا ۖ فَإِنَّهَا لَا تَعْمَى ٱلْأَبْصَٰرُ وَلَٰكِن تَعْمَى ٱلْقُلُوبُ ٱلَّتِى فِى ٱلصُّدُورِ

words.gloss_range: fused interrogative plus consequential connector opening a reproachful question
words.prose: The fused opening {{ar:أَفَ}} ({{tr:ʾa-fa}}) makes the ayah begin as a rebuke already attached to prior ruin evidence (22:45). Before the content words arrive, the discourse mode is accountability: travel, hearts, ears, eyes, and chests will all unfold inside that demanded response.

topics.headline: rebuke joined to prior evidence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opening is not a neutral question but a rebuke linked to the ruined settlements just mentioned (22:45).
topics.reason: The hamza-plus-fa compound introduces interrogation with consequential linkage, and boundary evidence ties it to the prior ruin report (22:45).

topics.headline: question starts a narrowing architecture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah moving from public evidence to inner diagnosis rather than offering isolated lexical observations.
topics.reason: The rows describe a four-beat progression from rhetorical question to purpose, correction, and embodied conclusion.

words.gloss_range: jussive negator converting the travel verb into reproachful past negation
words.prose: {{ar:لَمْ}} ({{tr:lam}}) makes the journey an unmet obligation, not a merely hypothetical option. Its negation reaches into the purpose chain, so failure to travel through the evidence also means failure to acquire hearts and ears that would perceive. A nearby destroyed-town echo in 22:48 broadens the ruin field, while 22:45 remains the immediate setup.

topics.headline: expected journey left undone
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the question rebukes a missed act that should already have happened.
topics.reason: The particle governs the following jussive travel verb and gives the clause past-negating force inside the rhetorical question.

topics.headline: prior ruins become an obligation to read
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ruins of 22:45 are not background; they are evidence the audience failed to pursue.
topics.reason: The rows connect the negated journey with the destroyed settlements in 22:45 and with the same ruined-town field continued in 22:48.

topics.headline: nearby destroyed-town echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a same-surah ruined-town field, while the local grammar still makes 22:45 the immediate setup.
topics.reason: The 22:48 echo supports the ruined-town field, but it does not replace the immediate syntactic role of the negation in 22:46.

words.gloss_range: Form I intransitive travel under negated jussive governance
words.root_gloss_range: movement through land, conduct, and route-pattern associations; local sense is physical travel made evidentiary

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: jussive negator governing the travel verb

words.prose: {{ar:يَسِيرُوا۟}} ({{tr:yasīrū}}) is travel the rebuked group itself failed to undertake, with the jussive form visibly governed by {{ar:لَمْ}} ({{tr:lam}}). The root field makes the movement more than locomotion: in the recurring travel-in-the-land formula, physical route becomes empirical investigation, while the local Form I keeps responsibility on the travelers rather than on someone sending them. The verb also governs the purpose chain in which outer travel should lead to hearts and ears coming to function.

topics.headline: jussive travel under negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the surface form carrying the force of a missed past journey.
topics.reason: The five-verbs plural lacks the indicative ending under the governance of the prior jussive negator.

topics.headline: travel as investigation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that travel is a way of reading signs in the land, not scenic motion.
topics.reason: The root-plus-land formula recurs as an epistemic summons, including 12:109, 30:9, 35:44, 40:21, 40:82, and 47:10.

topics.headline: Form I keeps agency on travelers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the wording faults the travelers for not moving through the evidence themselves.
topics.reason: The local Form I is intransitive travel; broader conduct or biography associations support responsibility but do not change the local verb into a causative form.

topics.headline: journey governs perception result
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that outer movement is syntactically ordered toward inner faculty formation.
topics.reason: The travel clause is the parent for the result-purpose clause that introduces hearts and ears as the intended outcome.

words.gloss_range: locative preposition making the land an encompassing travel domain
words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) makes the land the field through which evidence is encountered, not the object acted upon. Its first spatial frame is later answered by the closing {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) before the chests, so the ayah can move from outer domain to inner container.

topics.headline: land as traversed domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that evidence surrounds the travelers as a domain to be crossed.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the land noun as a locative complement of the travel verb.

topics.headline: first half of spatial mirror
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the opening spatial preposition setting up the final inward location.
topics.reason: The same preposition frames the external land near the opening and the chests at the close.

words.gloss_range: definite singular land as a known evidence-field for travel
words.root_gloss_range: ground, earth, territory, and domain; local phrase selects the traversed evidence-field
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:al-ʾarḍi}}) is not a vague landscape. Its definiteness gathers the ruined settlement evidence of 22:45 into one known field, and the root range lets that field be physical ground, inhabited territory, and evidentiary domain at once; decay associations remain color, not the selected sense. Its pairing with travel also marks earth as the recurring domain where signs are inspected.

topics.headline: known land of signs
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the land is already loaded with the ruined nodes named in 22:45.
topics.reason: The singular definite noun is the governed locative complement and is linked by boundary evidence to the previous settlement ruins (22:45).

topics.headline: ground, territory, and domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the travel field is concrete terrain with civilizational and evidentiary force, while blight imagery remains contextual color.
topics.reason: The local phrase selects land as traversed terrain; broader territory and decay branches enrich the ruin scene without becoming separate local denotations.

topics.headline: earth as travel domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this is part of a Quranic pattern where earth is the domain that must be inspected.
topics.reason: The co-occurrence profile strongly links the land root with the travel root, and same-surah recurrence narrows the broad earth theme to evidentiary traversal here.

words.gloss_range: causal-result connector introducing the purpose clause after travel
words.prose: The second {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) is the hinge from geography to cognition. It makes hearts and ears the result or purpose of the demanded journey, so the faculties are not decorative additions after travel.

topics.headline: external motion to inner faculty
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the grammar itself turns travel into a route toward perception.
topics.reason: The connector introduces the result-purpose clause governed by the travel question.

words.gloss_range: subjunctive existential verb: faculties would come to be for them
words.root_gloss_range: being, becoming, occurrence, and existence; local clause selects existential coming-to-be
words.prose: {{ar:تَكُونَ}} ({{tr:takūna}}) casts reasoning hearts and hearing ears as unrealized potential after the missed journey. The verb is existential rather than merely descriptive: the issue is whether such faculties would come to be for them, with feminine agreement in the standard reading and a masculine accepted variant showing the flexibility of broken-plural agreement.

topics.headline: subjunctive potential after causal connector
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that functioning faculties are possible outcomes withheld by the failed response.
topics.reason: The verb is subjunctive after the result connector, marking potential rather than achieved possession.

topics.headline: broken-plural agreement pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the surface gender of the verb is a grammatical choice around a following broken plural, not a change in the thesis.
topics.reason: The standard feminine singular form agrees with the following broken plural, and the masculine variant preserves the same existential clause.

topics.headline: faculties come to be
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clause concerns acquisition of functioning faculties, while the local Form I does not add causative formation language.
topics.reason: The local verb selects existential coming-to-be; broader formation possibilities are limited by the Form I surface.

topics.headline: becoming joins travel to perception
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the hinge where movement through evidence is supposed to yield cognitive possession.
topics.reason: Co-occurrence evidence links the becoming field with travel and heart fields, matching the local result clause.

words.gloss_range: bound dative preposition marking possession-benefit before the pronoun
words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) makes the coming-to-be clause about possession and benefit: hearts and ears would be for the rebuked group. Because the preposition is bound forward into the pronoun, the grammar leans toward the people who lack those faculties.

topics.headline: faculties for them
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the problem is cast as lacking possessed faculties, not lacking evidence.
topics.reason: The dative preposition attaches to the existential verb and is completed by the following pronoun.

words.gloss_range: attached plural pronoun naming the rebuked group as beneficiary of potential faculties
words.prose: {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) keeps the same group in view: the ones who failed to travel are the ones for whom hearts and ears should have come to be. The single beneficiary slot covers both faculties, so hearts and ears do not divide the audience; they measure one group against two routes of perception, with same-surah heart states sharpening the diagnosis (22:32; 22:53; 22:54).

topics.headline: same group receives both possible faculties
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that both heart-reasoning and ear-hearing are possibilities for the same failed audience.
topics.reason: The pronoun in the preposed dative phrase refers back to the travel-subject and frames both coordinated faculty nouns.

topics.headline: suffix inside the possession phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the pronoun is not a fresh subject but the beneficiary completing the dative phrase.
topics.reason: The pronoun is genitive after the bound preposition and does not restart the clause.

topics.headline: same-surah heart diagnosis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices this group being evaluated within a same-surah pattern of hearts marked by reverence, disease, hardness, humility, and blindness (22:32; 22:53; 22:54).
topics.reason: The rows connect the pronoun group with same-surah heart-state passages at 22:32, 22:53, and 22:54.

words.gloss_range: indefinite plural hearts of a needed reasoning quality
words.root_gloss_range: heart, turning, inversion, and shaping associations; local noun names possible functioning hearts
words.prose: {{ar:قُلُوبٌ}} ({{tr:qulūbun}}) does not say their existing hearts; the indefiniteness names hearts of a needed quality, defined by reasoning through them. The turning and shaping root pressure makes the heart a responsive center, while the later definite {{ar:ٱلْقُلُوبُ}} ({{tr:al-qulūbu}}) exposes the gap between possible reasoning hearts and actual blind hearts. Its indefinite cadence also pairs it with the later ears before the two distinct functions are assigned.

topics.headline: possible hearts of quality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah asks for hearts of a functioning kind, not merely possession of organs.
topics.reason: The noun is an indefinite broken plural and becomes defined by the following reasoning clause.

topics.headline: faculty as unrealized subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the heart itself is what would come to be in the result clause.
topics.reason: The noun is nominative as the delayed subject of the existential verb.

topics.headline: turning and shaping pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the heart as an inner center capable of turning and shaping perception, while the local phrase still names hearts rather than molds or revolutions.
topics.reason: Root branches of turning and shaping enrich the noun but are locally narrowed by the surface plural heart form.

topics.headline: heart as perception organ
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that hearts belong to a theological and perceptual field, not an emotion-only category.
topics.reason: Co-occurrence and same-surah profiles link hearts with reasoning, faith, hearing, sight, and heart-state taxonomy.

topics.headline: potential-to-actual contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah setting up its own later reversal from possible reasoning hearts to identified blind hearts.
topics.reason: The intra-ayah recurrence shifts from indefinite potential hearts to definite diagnosed hearts.

topics.headline: paired indefinite cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices hearts and ears sounding like a paired set before their distinct functions are named.
topics.reason: The tanwīn cadence links the two coordinated indefinite faculty nouns.

words.gloss_range: imperfect plural reasoning performed by means of the hearts
words.root_gloss_range: binding, restraining, and reasoning; local verb selects active understanding through the heart
words.prose: {{ar:يَعْقِلُونَ}} ({{tr:yaʿqilūna}}) defines the needed hearts by what the people would do through them. The root image of binding makes reasoning the ordering of impressions into judgment, and the imperfect plural makes it an active process, paired grammatically and rhythmically with hearing by means of ears. That binding is also the needed communal response to signs and to the disorder displayed by the ruined settlements of 22:45.

topics.headline: reasoning by hearts
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the heart is made the instrument of reasoning.
topics.reason: The following instrumental phrase routes the action of reasoning through the heart-pronoun.

topics.headline: reason as binding impressions
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices reason as disciplined binding and ordering, while the local verb remains ordinary reasoning rather than physical hobbling.
topics.reason: The root image of binding supports the cognitive sense but is narrowed by the local imperfect reasoning verb.

topics.headline: imperfect activity not static label
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that understanding is enacted repeatedly, not merely possessed as a label.
topics.reason: The verb is imperfect plural, and distribution evidence shows the root overwhelmingly in imperfect process forms.

topics.headline: reasoning answers signs and disorder
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices reasoning as the needed communal response to signs and to the disorder visible in ruined settlements.
topics.reason: The co-occurrence field links reasoning with signs, people, travel, earth, and hearing, while boundary evidence frames it as correction of misplacement.

topics.headline: reasoning paired with hearing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices heart-reasoning and ear-hearing as formally equivalent routes to perception.
topics.reason: The verb-plus-instrument pattern and cadence parallel the later hearing clause.

words.gloss_range: instrumental preposition plus feminine pronoun referring to the hearts
words.prose: The first {{ar:بِهَا}} ({{tr:bihā}}) fuses instrument marker and pronoun, making the hearts the means of reasoning. Its feminine singular pronoun is not a new referent; it routes back to the broken-plural hearts and sets the template repeated for ears.

topics.headline: by means of the hearts
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that reasoning is explicitly embodied through the heart-pronoun.
topics.reason: The instrumental preposition and feminine singular pronoun refer back to the non-rational broken plural hearts.

topics.headline: first instrument refrain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the first half of a repeated organ-plus-instrument pattern.
topics.reason: The same compact form recurs after the hearing verb for ears.

words.gloss_range: disjunctive coordinator presenting two possible epistemic instruments
words.prose: {{ar:أَوْ}} ({{tr:ʾaw}}) keeps hearts and ears as distinct routes of perception. The alternation can indict failure by either route while the parallel grammar lets both stand together, so cognitive binding and auditory reception do not collapse into one faculty.

topics.headline: alternative instruments of perception
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that either a reasoning heart or a hearing ear would have been enough to make the evidence accountable.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the two nominative faculties while preserving their distinction inside the result clause.

words.gloss_range: indefinite plural ears of a needed receptive quality
words.root_gloss_range: ear, permission, authorization, and proclamation; local noun selects receptive organs
words.prose: {{ar:ءَاذَانٌ}} ({{tr:ʾādhānun}}) parallels the indefinite hearts as a second faculty that would come to be for them. The root field of ear, permission, and announcement makes hearing a receptive gateway, while the local surface remains concrete ears coordinated with hearts and assigned their own matching function.

topics.headline: ears of receptive quality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clause asks for ears capable of receptive perception, not mere anatomy.
topics.reason: The indefinite broken plural matches the earlier indefinite hearts and is defined by the following hearing clause.

topics.headline: second faculty under becoming
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices ears coordinated with hearts as a parallel acquired instrument.
topics.reason: The noun is a nominative coordinate with the heart noun under the same existential verb and receives a matching function.

topics.headline: ear as gateway of reception
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices hearing as receptive openness with permission and proclamation resonances, while the selected local form remains the ear organ.
topics.reason: The root family includes permission and announcement, but the surface plural selects concrete ears as the local referent.

topics.headline: ear in the perception field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices ears participating in a wider field of hearing, heart, sight, permission, and proclamation within the surah.
topics.reason: Co-occurrence and same-surah evidence integrate the ear root with hearing, heart, sight, and proclamation fields.

words.gloss_range: imperfect plural hearing performed by means of ears
words.root_gloss_range: hearing, listening, learning by hearing, and obeying; local verb selects hearing with receptive-response pressure
words.prose: {{ar:يَسْمَعُونَ}} ({{tr:yasmaʿūna}}) completes the ear route with the same verb-plus-instrument pattern used for reasoning. The root range lets hearing imply receptive response and obedience, while the Form I surface keeps the demanded minimum as hearing itself; the ayah then splits the usual hearing-and-sight pair by sending true failure toward hearts.

topics.headline: hearing by ears
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices hearing and reasoning presented in the same grammatical frame.
topics.reason: The verb is completed by the following instrumental phrase, matching the earlier reasoning construction.

topics.headline: hearing with obedience pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that hearing carries response-pressure, while the local Form I does not specify an intensive listening stem.
topics.reason: The root includes listening and obeying, but the local form is basic Form I hearing rather than an intensive or causative form.

topics.headline: hearing-sight pair rerouted
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the standard hearing-sight pairing being interrupted by the heart diagnosis.
topics.reason: The co-occurrence profile makes hearing and sight a dominant pair, while this ayah assigns hearing to ears and relocates blindness away from sight to hearts.

topics.headline: paired imperfect cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the two imperfect plurals sounding paired before the blindness pivot.
topics.reason: The two verbs share the plural imperfect cadence followed by the same instrumental phrase.

words.gloss_range: second instrumental preposition plus feminine pronoun referring to ears
words.prose: The second {{ar:بِهَا}} ({{tr:bihā}}) routes the pronoun back to the ears and makes them the instrument of hearing. Its repeated shape forms a refrain with the earlier heart phrase, pairing the faculties without erasing their separate functions.

topics.headline: by means of the ears
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ear clause completing the same embodied-instrument grammar as the heart clause.
topics.reason: The feminine singular pronoun refers to the non-rational broken plural ears and is fused with the instrumental preposition.

topics.headline: instrumental refrain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the repeated instrumental word as a local echo linking the two faculties.
topics.reason: Exact repetition after both verbs gives the two clauses a shared refrain.

words.gloss_range: explanatory connector introducing the diagnosis after the faculty clause
words.prose: The third {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) turns the travel question into diagnosis. After the possible hearts and ears, it introduces the rule that explains the failure, and the same defective response continues into the impatient challenge that follows (22:47).

topics.headline: question becomes diagnosis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final clause explains why external signs do not automatically produce perception.
topics.reason: The connector introduces the explanatory emphatic clause after the travel and faculty clauses.

topics.headline: third connective escalation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a sequence of connective turns: challenge, purpose, then explanation.
topics.reason: Rows track the three major connective pivots in the ayah and identify word 17 as the explanatory one.

topics.headline: diagnosis anticipates impatience
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the diagnosis preparing for the continued faulty response in 22:47.
topics.reason: Boundary evidence links the diagnosed failure here with the next ayah challenge in 22:47.

words.gloss_range: emphatic particle plus pronoun introducing the affair or matter of the diagnosis
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّهَا}} ({{tr:innahā}}) does not need a simple concrete antecedent. It can introduce the affair itself, while still allowing a matter-or-situation reading; that controlled ambiguity makes the blindness statement both a general truth and a pointed diagnosis. The human perception failure announced here is later set against divine hearing and seeing in 22:61.

topics.headline: pronoun of the affair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clause announces a proposition rather than merely pointing back to a nearby noun.
topics.reason: The pronoun can function as a pronoun of the affair before the predicate that follows.

topics.headline: general truth and pointed matter
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the statement landing as both principle and diagnosis.
topics.reason: Alternative referential readings remain live, but both serve the same corrective declaration rather than changing the local syntax.

topics.headline: confirmed corrective declaration
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices resistance being met with emphatic clarification.
topics.reason: The emphatic particle and pronoun are fused in one word that pivots into the blindness correction.

topics.headline: human perception contrasted later
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices human sight failure later set against divine hearing and seeing in 22:61.
topics.reason: The same-surah contrast links the human perception diagnosis here with the divine attribute formula in 22:61.

words.gloss_range: local negator denying blindness of the eyes clause
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) negates blindness only in the eye clause. It creates the first half of the correction, so the following adversative can relocate the same blindness predicate to hearts.

topics.headline: not the eyes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the negation clearing the expected locus before the correction names the real one.
topics.reason: The negator scopes over the first blindness verb and prepares the adversative correction pattern.

words.gloss_range: first blindness verb, grammatically normal with eyes but locally negated
words.root_gloss_range: blindness, obscuring, and error associations; first use stages literal eye-blindness for denial
words.prose: The first {{ar:تَعْمَى}} ({{tr:taʿmā}}) is a normal eye-blindness predicate in form, with feminine singular agreement before a broken-plural subject, but it is negated. That denial stages the literal domain so the same verb can return with changed polarity and a heart subject; broader obscuring and error senses remain pressure for the relocation, not the first clause’s direct assertion.

topics.headline: normal eye-blindness clause form
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices ordinary grammar being used to set up an extraordinary correction.
topics.reason: The feminine singular verb precedes a broken-plural subject in standard verbal-sentence order.

topics.headline: literal blindness denied before transfer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah first placing blindness where expected and then removing it so metaphorical relocation can happen.
topics.reason: The same predicate is negated with eyes and later affirmed with hearts, performing a semantic transfer.

topics.headline: obscuring pressure held for relocation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices obscuring and perception-field pressure, while the local first verb remains simple intransitive blindness under negation.
topics.reason: Broader obscuring branches are limited by the Form I intransitive surface and by the immediate negation of the eye clause.

topics.headline: same verb with reversed polarity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that comparison is forced by repeating the same verb while changing negation and subject.
topics.reason: The construction restricts true blindness away from eyes and onto hearts through negation followed by adversative affirmation.

words.gloss_range: definite visual faculties as the expected subject whose blindness is denied
words.root_gloss_range: external sight and insight/discernment; local plural selects visual faculties cleared by negation
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَبْصَٰرُ}} ({{tr:al-ʾabṣāru}}) names the familiar visual faculties everyone would assume to be the locus of blindness. The ayah denies blindness there, separating optical sight from deeper discernment and preparing the transfer to hearts; the usual hearing-sight pair is thereby rerouted, and human visual insufficiency later contrasts with divine seeing (22:61; 22:75).

topics.headline: expected eye subject cleared
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the familiar organ of blindness being named precisely so it can be excluded.
topics.reason: The definite noun is nominative as delayed subject of the negated blindness verb.

topics.headline: external sight separated from insight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that visual faculties are not enough for discernment, while the local form still names sight rather than the abstract insight derivative.
topics.reason: The root spans sight and insight, but the local plural visual-faculty form is the denied subject.

topics.headline: hearing-sight pair interrupted by hearts
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the expected hearing-sight dyad yielding to a heart-centered diagnosis.
topics.reason: The root profile pairs sight with hearing, yet this ayah introduces hearts as the true locus of failed perception.

topics.headline: negated half before heart clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a two-step correction: expected locus named and denied, then actual locus affirmed.
topics.reason: The noun closes the negated half immediately before the adversative heart clause.

topics.headline: human sight versus divine seeing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices human visual faculties here being insufficient against later divine seeing in 22:61 and 22:75.
topics.reason: Same-surah recurrence contrasts human visual limitation with divine sight attributes at 22:61 and 22:75.

words.gloss_range: connector joining the negated clause to the adversative correction

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: light adversative particle introducing the correction

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) does more than add another clause. Before {{ar:لَٰكِنْ}} ({{tr:lākin}}), it keeps the denied eye-blindness and affirmed heart-blindness bound into one corrective structure.

topics.headline: joined correction across contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the two clauses are one correction, not two detached statements.
topics.reason: The connector joins the negative clause to the adversative clause while preserving the contrast carried by the following particle.

words.gloss_range: light adversative particle introducing an independent corrective clause
words.prose: {{ar:لَٰكِنْ}} ({{tr:lākin}}) is the thesis-turn: not the eyes, but the hearts. Because it is the light, non-governing form, it corrects the assumed locus of blindness without taking over the case of the following clause.

topics.headline: non-governing adversative
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the correction is structurally independent, not a heavy particle governing a new accusative subject.
topics.reason: The visible light form introduces correction while leaving the following subject nominative under its own verb.

topics.headline: blindness moved from eyes to hearts
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah’s central move as a predicate transfer from the expected organ to the inner faculty.
topics.reason: The adversative pattern denies the same predicate of one subject and affirms it of another.

words.gloss_range: second blindness verb, now affirmed of hearts
words.root_gloss_range: blindness, obscuring, error, and ignorance; second use selects metaphorical cognitive-perceptive blindness
words.prose: The second {{ar:تَعْمَى}} ({{tr:taʿmā}}) sounds and looks like the first, but now the polarity and subject have changed. With hearts as subject, blindness becomes cognitive-perceptive failure and ignorance seated in the inner faculty; the repetition makes the relocation audible while the prior ruins supply an outer image of collapsed interiors (22:45).

topics.headline: same agreement with new subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same verb form attached to a different subject and opposite assignment.
topics.reason: The feminine singular verb repeats with the heart subject after being negated with the eye subject.

topics.headline: blind hearts as perceptive failure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices blindness becoming a metaphor for failed inner perception and ignorance.
topics.reason: The predicate is affirmed of hearts, allowing the error and ignorance branch to surface locally as cognitive failure.

topics.headline: sound identity carries reversal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same sound carrying a changed truth value and subject.
topics.reason: The exact repeated form creates a local echo that amplifies the semantic reversal.

topics.headline: ruin interior mirrored in heart blindness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ruined settlement interior of 22:45 becoming an analogue for failed human interior perception.
topics.reason: Boundary evidence links collapsed built interiors in 22:45 with the inner failure diagnosed in hearts here.

words.gloss_range: definite actual hearts as the subject of affirmed blindness
words.root_gloss_range: heart with turning and inversion associations; local noun identifies the actual hearts under diagnosis

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: indefinite possible hearts of a reasoning quality

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْقُلُوبُ}} ({{tr:al-qulūbu}}) occupies the same delayed-subject role as the eyes, making the transfer exact. Its definiteness contrasts with the earlier indefinite {{ar:قُلُوبٌ}} ({{tr:qulūbun}}): possible reasoning hearts have become the actual hearts under diagnosis, and the turning-root pressure makes the blindness feel like an inner faculty turned away from perception. The word also stands in the ayah's perception-and-container field: hearts are compared with eyes, stand beside ears, and are then localized in chests.

topics.headline: heart subject replaces eye subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the grammar making the eye-heart comparison direct.
topics.reason: The noun is definite nominative as delayed subject in the same position as the earlier eye subject.

topics.headline: actual hearts identified
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the formal shift from possible hearts to the actual hearts being judged.
topics.reason: The definite broken plural contrasts with the earlier indefinite heart noun and carries the diagnosis.

topics.headline: turned inner organ goes blind
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the organ named from turning becoming the locus of turned-away perception, while the local referent remains hearts.
topics.reason: The turning root image intensifies the metaphor but is narrowed by the surface heart plural and its subject role.

topics.headline: heart in perception and chest field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices hearts linked to sight, hearing, chests, and same-surah states of inner response.
topics.reason: Co-occurrence and same-surah evidence place hearts among perception roots and chest-container language.

words.gloss_range: feminine singular relative pronoun attaching a bodily location clause to the hearts
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّتِى}} ({{tr:allatī}}) locks the final relative clause to the broken-plural hearts. The agreement is standard, but the added location is marked: it grounds the metaphor in physical bodies and begins the shift from ruined built interiors in 22:45 to human inner housing.

topics.headline: relative pronoun tied to hearts
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final location clause modifies the hearts, not the blindness verb in general.
topics.reason: The feminine singular relative pronoun agrees with the non-rational broken plural hearts.

topics.headline: obvious location made emphatic
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah insisting that metaphorical blindness is located in embodied hearts.
topics.reason: The relative clause adds a bodily location that is semantically obvious but rhetorically emphatic.

topics.headline: building interior to body interior
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the prior interior-collapse imagery of 22:45 turning into bodily interior language.
topics.reason: Boundary evidence connects ruined structural interiors in 22:45 with the body-side interior opened by this relative clause.

words.gloss_range: locative preposition marking the chests as container for the hearts
words.prose: The closing {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) supplies physical containment: the hearts are in the chests. It also mirrors the opening travel phrase, so the ayah’s spatial path runs from evidence in the land to blindness in the chest.

topics.headline: hearts located in chests
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final diagnosis being placed inside a bodily container.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the chest noun as the locative complement in the relative clause.

topics.headline: land-to-chest spatial arc
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same preposition framing the outer journey and the inner locus of failure.
topics.reason: The opening and closing locative phrases mirror each other, moving from land to chests.

words.gloss_range: definite plural chests as the final locative container
words.root_gloss_range: chest, front, beginning, and source; local plural selects bodily containers with source-pressure
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلصُّدُورِ}} ({{tr:aṣ-ṣudūri}}) closes the ayah on definite bodily containers. The local form selects chests, not an abstract source noun, yet the root’s front-and-source pressure makes the final location the origin-place of failed perception; the chests are also containers of inward knowledge and perception, not merely anatomy. The outer land of the opening and the inner chest of the close form the ayah’s ring.

topics.headline: known bodily housing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final word is concrete bodily housing for the diagnosed hearts.
topics.reason: The definite plural noun is genitive after the locative preposition and completes the relative clause.

topics.headline: chest as source-place
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the chest as the place from which perception failure issues, while the local surface remains the plural chest noun.
topics.reason: The root connects chest, front, and source, but the selected form is not the source noun or an issuing verb.

topics.headline: chests as containers of inner knowledge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that chests are treated as containers of inward knowledge and perception, not merely anatomy.
topics.reason: Co-occurrence evidence links chest language with heart, perception, and knowledge fields.

topics.headline: final bodily landing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah ending by physically anchoring the relocated blindness.
topics.reason: After travel, faculties, sight, and heart-blindness, the final phrase lands on the bodily container.

topics.headline: land opening to chest closing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the whole ayah framed as movement from external terrain to internal failure.
topics.reason: The opening land phrase and closing chest phrase form an outer-inner frame.

topics.headline: settlement interior to body interior
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ruined interior of 22:45 answered by the human interior that houses a blind heart.
topics.reason: Boundary evidence maps architectural interior failure in 22:45 onto bodily interior language here.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: يسيروا في الأرض فتكون لهم قلوب يعقلون بها
baseline_models.mechanism: Motion through the encounterable earth supplies changing instances; فتكون presents an operative heart as an outcome, and عقل supplies restraint that binds impressions into judgment rather than leaving them as sights.

activation_trace.role: Going and flowing supplies literal movement and makes traversal the input stage of the cognitive mechanism.
The lower realm opposite the sky supplies the concrete field across which evidence is encountered.
Coming into occurrence or presence makes the reasoning heart an achieved operative state, not merely an anatomical possession.
The heart as organ of understanding supplies the interior processor that receives the journey's evidence.
Reason as a restraint against ignorance supplies the operation that checks and consolidates raw impressions.

changed_reading.before: Travel provides sights from which a person may learn.
changed_reading.after: Travel is an epistemic operation: changing exposure makes the heart operative, and reason restrains and binds observations into judgment.

baseline_models.mechanism: The heart is both the inner core and a site of turning; عقل tethers that mobility, while the breast is the source from which action issues. Heart-blindness is therefore failed reorientation at the center of conduct, not a shortage of visual data.

activation_trace.role: The pure core of a thing locates cognition at an inward center rather than at the visible surface.
Turning something from face to face supplies revisability and directional change as the heart's functional potential.
Tethering a camel supplies a material image for harnessing the heart's turns into stable inference.
The source from which actions issue makes the breast an upstream seat whose condition reaches outward conduct.

changed_reading.before: The heart is a static container that either has understanding or lacks it.
changed_reading.after: The heart is a turnable inner core; healthy reason harnesses revision into orientation, while blindness disables course correction at the source of action.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: قلوب يعقلون بها أو آذان يسمعون بها
baseline_models.mechanism: The parallel clauses distinguish rather than merely duplicate cognition: the heart binds and infers, while the ear attends, accepts, understands, and can enact transmitted meaning. Anatomical presence alone guarantees neither operation.

activation_trace.role: Attentive listening and acceptance turn the ear from passive anatomy into a gate of uptake.
Understanding, accepting, and acting on speech supply the functional consequence of successful hearing.
Insight of the heart distinguishes interpreted evidence from the eye's mere registration of a scene.

changed_reading.before: The verse lists two roughly equivalent sensory faculties.
changed_reading.after: It offers complementary evidence channels: hearts infer from encountered traces, while ears admit and respond to transmitted testimony.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: لا تعمى الأبصار ولكن تعمى القلوب التي في الصدور
baseline_models.mechanism: The explicit negation and correction relocate failure from ocular capacity to inward insight. Repetition of عمى first evokes literal loss of sight and then overrides it with heart-blindness, locating the defect upstream of perception and action.

activation_trace.role: Literal loss of eyesight supplies the rejected diagnosis against which the correction works.
Loss of inner insight supplies the retained diagnosis: inability to find the argument or path despite available input.
The eye's ordinary seeing supplies intact downstream sensory hardware that is explicitly exonerated.
The heart as understanding and spirit supplies the actual site of diagnostic failure.
The bodily chest keeps the relocated failure embodied and interior rather than abstractly intellectual.

changed_reading.before: Blindness is used as a general metaphor for ignorance.
changed_reading.after: The sentence performs a diagnosis: sensory registration may remain intact while the embodied, action-producing center cannot convert input into insight.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening scene shows behavior correctly but corrects its apparent category: people look intoxicated yet are not. The following sequence moves from dispute without disclosed knowledge to following and misguidance. This revises heart-blindness into failed causal classification rather than absent visual input.

activation_trace.role: Eye-seeing together with insight supplies a scene whose appearance still requires correct interpretation.
Loss of sobriety supplies the visually plausible but explicitly rejected causal label.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the epistemic state absent from the ensuing dispute.
Deviation from guidance supplies the downstream result of accepting the wrong explanatory lead.
Inner blindness anchors the contextual sequence back to failure to identify the argument or way.

structural_cues: 22:2 preserves the visible behavior while negating the observer's first causal classification.
22:3-4 then sequence unsupported dispute, following, and misdirection.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies accurate-looking perception, an explicit reclassification, and a later path from unsupported claim to misguidance; I infer that the heart must discriminate causes behind appearances. A live alternative is that the opening correction only intensifies terror and does not define ordinary cognition.

changed_reading.before: Heart-blindness means failing to notice what the eyes present.
changed_reading.after: Heart-blindness can mean seeing the behavior yet assigning the wrong cause, then following that untested classification into misdirection.

context_deltas.mechanism: Worship from a tilted edge is tested, then becomes an inversion onto one's face. The shared قلب root turns the focus heart into an orienting mechanism: reason should permit evidence-led turning without the trial-driven reversal that overturns commitment.

activation_trace.role: Inclination away from a direction supplies the unstable edge-position from which reversal becomes easy.
Testing metal or a person supplies pressure that reveals whether an orientation is structurally stable.
Turning from one face to another supplies the explicit contextual reversal that activates the focus heart's directional capacity.
Direction and facing give the reversal a spatial endpoint rather than leaving it as an abstract change of opinion.
Reason's restraint anchors the delta as disciplined orientation rather than mere persistence.

structural_cues: 22:11 aligns edge, trial, inversion, face, and loss in one bodily sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies tilt, testing, reversal, and a new facing; I infer that the heart mediates orientation and that عقل stabilizes revision without collapse. The live alternative is that انقلب is only an idiom for apostasy and contributes no cognitive mechanics.

changed_reading.before: A reasoning heart simply possesses correct propositions.
changed_reading.after: A reasoning heart maintains and revises orientation under pressure; blindness is susceptibility to a wholesale, face-first reversal rather than evidence-led turning.

context_deltas.mechanism: An announced call produces bodily arrivals through distant open passes. The حج inventory joins intentional movement toward the revered with prevailing proof, so heard testimony and traveled route can form one evidentiary circuit rather than separate religious acts.

activation_trace.role: Public notification by a call supplies an audible signal designed to cross distance and initiate response.
Intentional movement toward what is magnified supplies the journey's directed bodily purpose.
Prevailing proof supplies the latent evidentiary face of the same contextual root.
A broad opening between mountains supplies the concrete channel through which response becomes travel.
Depth and remoteness of a road supply the distance over which hearing becomes costly embodied action.
Literal going anchors the call-and-response circuit in the focus command to traverse.
Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies the conversion from signal to journey.

structural_cues: 22:27 sequences proclamation, arrival, walking or mounted travel, and convergence from every deep pass.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a call, directed pilgrimage, a root branch for proof, and long-distance arrival; I infer that enacting the heard call can itself produce evidence and understanding. A live alternative keeps حج's pilgrimage and proof branches separate and reads the verse only as mobilization.

changed_reading.before: Travel and hearing are independent ways of receiving signs.
changed_reading.after: A heard call can launch a directed journey whose enactment becomes proof: auditory acceptance and movement jointly make the heart able to reason.

context_deltas.mechanism: Ritual markers are traced to protective disposition in hearts; remembrance makes hearts tremble, and the material offering's flesh and blood do not reach while that disposition does. The reasoning heart is thus an affective and practical transducer from sign to guarded conduct, not a detached calculator.

activation_trace.role: A perceptible ritual marker supplies an outward sign that must be converted into an inward disposition.
Protection that repels harm supplies the operative moral disposition attributed to hearts.
The heart as understanding and affect supplies the inward site where the outward marker becomes protection.
Fear felt by the heart supplies an embodied response showing that cognition here includes affective movement.
The repeated heart locates remembrance's bodily-affective effect in the same organ that reasons in the focus.
Reaching and attaining supply the transfer test that distinguishes inward response from offered matter.
Literal flesh supplies one material component explicitly denied efficacy in the transfer.
Literal blood supplies the second material component explicitly contrasted with inward protection.
The focus heart anchors this ritual conversion back to the organ that reasons or becomes blind.

structural_cues: 22:32 locates reverence for outward markers in hearts.
22:35 makes remembrance produce a heart response and practical endurance, prayer, and giving.
22:37 denies efficacy to flesh and blood while affirming an inward disposition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sign, heart-disposition, bodily affect, and ensuing practice, plus a material/nonmaterial transfer contrast; I infer a transduction mechanism from perception to conduct. A live alternative treats these as separate virtues without a shared cognitive process.

changed_reading.before: Reasoning by the heart is mainly discursive understanding.
changed_reading.after: Heart-reason includes converting signs and remembrance into protective affect and sustained conduct; blindness is a broken sign-to-response transfer.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence of denied communities becomes a material scene: a gathered settlement has perished, its raised structures are empty or collapsed, its well is idle, yet an enclosed elevated building remains. Travel is forensic reconstruction from patterned residues, while hearing supplies the transmitted sequence that identifies the absent agents and temporal cause.

activation_trace.role: People gathered into a settlement supply the vanished social system whose remains must be interpreted.
Falling into destruction supplies the event whose causes the traveler must reconstruct.
Emptiness supplies negative evidence: human use is absent though material traces remain.
Falling and collapse supply the altered spatial relation from which prior structure can be inferred.
Raised roofs and coverings supply the structural layer now displaced by collapse.
The excavated well supplies communal water infrastructure whose state records interrupted life.
Emptiness and disabling make nonuse, rather than mere physical presence, evidentiary.
An enclosed building supplies the contrasting residue of concentrated protection and status.
Raised, strengthened construction supplies durability that nevertheless fails to preserve its social world.
Literal traversal anchors forensic inspection in the focus journey.
Reason's restraint supplies the disciplined inference that joins residues without overclaiming any single object.
Understanding transmitted speech supplies historical testimony to combine with the visible material archive.

structural_cues: 22:42-44 names a succession of denying peoples and delayed seizure.
22:45 abruptly converts that narrated history into differentiated material residues immediately before the focus question.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a historical sequence and a patterned ruin scene; I infer that the traveler abductively reconstructs vanished communal action by combining testimony with object states. Natural decay remains a live local alternative for any one residue, so the causal reading depends on the sequence rather than an isolated ruin.

changed_reading.before: Travel exposes the observer to generic cautionary ruins.
changed_reading.after: Travel becomes forensic fieldwork: heart-reason reconstructs an absent society from collapse, vacancy, disabled infrastructure, and surviving fortification, while hearing supplies its narrated history.

context_deltas.mechanism: Haste is opposed by a promise indexed to a radically expanded day, followed by a settlement granted time before seizure and destination. The reasoning heart must model delayed outcomes across unlike temporal scales; otherwise present respite will be misread as causal absence.

activation_trace.role: Hastening and premature presentation supply the cognitive pressure to demand an immediate outcome.
A promise bounded by time or place supplies an outcome whose truth is not tested at the impatient observer's horizon.
A thousand as an aggregation of hundreds supplies the expanded magnitude of the comparison.
The year branch supplies the human temporal unit multiplied beyond immediate observation.
Counting the numbered supplies the human measurement frame explicitly placed under comparison.
Extended time and respite supply the long latent interval between conduct and visible consequence.
Becoming toward an outcome supplies the endpoint that makes the long interval a trajectory rather than stasis.
Restraint against ignorance anchors the model in resisting presentist judgment.

structural_cues: 22:47 juxtaposes demanded haste, unfailing promise, and a day measured against a thousand counted years.
22:48 repeats the ruined-settlement pattern as respite followed by seizure and final destination.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies impatience, unequal time scales, respite, and eventual outcome; I infer a long-lag causal model that the traveler can test against historical remains. A live alternative reads the thousand-year comparison only as divine transcendence, not as instruction in human causal patience.

changed_reading.before: Ruins demonstrate a simple and immediate link between wrongdoing and collapse.
changed_reading.after: The traveling heart must reason across latency: long respite can coexist with a fixed trajectory, so present nonoccurrence does not refute eventual consequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Material can be cast into a recited communication, removed and replaced, then made firm; the same episode becomes trial for diseased or hardened hearts but disclosure of truth to knowers whose hearts yield. Hearing therefore requires discrimination and correction at the heart, not unfiltered acoustic intake.

activation_trace.role: Casting something down supplies intrusive material entering the communication stream.
Removal followed by replacement supplies an explicit correction stage rather than mere suppression.
Making firm, exact, and secure supplies stabilization after correction.
The repeated hearts supply recipient states that make one communication yield divergent outcomes.
Darkening and reduced clarity supply one mechanism by which reception becomes opaque.
Loss of the heart's softness supplies a second failure mode: resistance rather than confusion.
Disclosure to the knower supplies the contrasting successful reception state.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies what successful discrimination recognizes.
Understanding and acceptance anchor the correction sequence back to the focus's functional hearing.
Obfuscation and induced ambiguity supply a focus-root image for corrupted interpretation without deafness.

structural_cues: 22:52 sequences insertion, removal, and confirmation within transmitted discourse.
22:53-54 contrast diseased or hardened hearts with knowing, believing, yielding hearts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a noisy transmission, explicit correction, stabilization, and divergent recipient states; I infer an error-correcting model of hearing mediated by the heart. A live alternative confines the sequence to prophetic transmission and declines to generalize it to ordinary reception.

changed_reading.before: Ears hear when an intelligible message reaches them.
changed_reading.after: Functional hearing is error-correcting uptake: the heart must distinguish intrusion, accept correction, and recognize stabilized truth; opacity or hardness can defeat hearing without deafness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later seeing formulas expose processes rather than static objects: water arrives and earth greens; a vessel runs through broad water; the sky is held from falling except by permission. Travel can therefore train relational reasoning about inputs, transitions, enabling, restraint, and contingency, alongside its historical reading of ruins.

activation_trace.role: Eye-seeing joined to insight introduces an observable transition rather than an isolated object.
Soft, sprouting earth supplies a receptive substrate whose changed state records the arrival of water.
Fresh green growth supplies the visible output of the preceding input-and-substrate relation.
A vessel moving in water supplies a human-scale system operating within a larger medium.
Flowing motion supplies the observable operation of that system.
Broad abundant water supplies the medium that enables movement while exceeding the vessel.
Holding and restraining supply a blocking relation that maintains the observed order.
Falling and settling supply the counterfactual event currently prevented.
Permission supplies the stated condition under which restraint could yield to the event.
Traversal anchors process observation in the focus's mobile epistemic practice.

structural_cues: 22:63 gives a compact input-to-state-change sequence under a command to see.
22:65 combines terrestrial affordance, maritime motion, active restraint, a counterfactual fall, and a permission condition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ordered transitions and explicit enabling or blocking relations; I infer that the traveler can learn by comparing process states and counterfactuals. A live alternative treats these only as signs of power and does not license a general systems-reading method.

changed_reading.before: Travel mainly reveals historical remains from which past outcomes are inferred.
changed_reading.after: Travel also exposes living process fields in which heart-reason tracks inputs, transitions, constraints, and contingent outcomes in the present.

context_deltas.mechanism: A command to listen introduces a compact analogy whose relations can be mentally run: collective claimants cannot make the tiny agent, nor recover what it removes; seeker and sought are jointly weak. Hearing is successful when it models the relations and accepts their implication, making the parable a portable counterpart to travel-based observation.

activation_trace.role: Depicting and making a comparison manifest supplies the construction of a mental test scene.
A comparison functioning as lesson and sign supplies the inferential purpose of the depicted scene.
Understanding, acceptance, and compliance make the command to listen demand more than acoustic registration.
The literal fly supplies a minimal, ordinary agent against which grand claims are tested.
Gathering dispersed actors into one whole supplies the strongest proposed capability of the claimants.
Extracting something from another's possession supplies the failed recovery operation.
The opposite of strength supplies the conclusion generated by the failed creation and recovery tests.
Seeking and searching supply the reciprocal roles whose joint weakness closes the model.
Attentive acceptance anchors the parable's command back to the focus ear's functional openness.

structural_cues: 22:73 places the listening command before a sequence of capability tests and a relational conclusion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a command to listen, a depicted analogy, failed operations, and a conclusion; I infer that the hearer is meant to execute the relational model mentally. A live alternative treats the comparison as ridicule whose force is affective rather than experimentally inferential.

changed_reading.before: Ears hear testimony that reports facts unavailable to the traveler.
changed_reading.after: Ears can receive a portable experiment: functional hearing runs the parable's relations, tests capacity claims, and accepts the inferred consequence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates two form-distant land idioms inside sensory roots: blindness as an unmarked land and hearing as walking where nobody hears or sees. It remains anchored in the exact focus roots and in the immediately preceding emptied settlement; downstream prose should present it as a spatial reversal of the scene, not as the lexical translation of تعمى or يسمعون.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يسيروا في الأرض ... يسمعون ... تعمى ... الأبصار

activation_trace.role: Unknown land without tracks or landmarks supplies a spatial image for evidence that the blind heart cannot navigate.
Walking in empty land where no one hears or sees supplies an idiom that unexpectedly gathers the focus's earth, travel, hearing, and sight.
Literal movement keeps the spatial resonance attached to the actual journey.
The concrete earth supplies the terrain in which cognitive wayfinding is tested.
Emptiness immediately before the focus turns the idiom's unobserved open land into a populated-by-traces but depopulated scene.

changed_reading.before: The travelers move through visible territory but fail to draw a moral lesson.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the verse reverses the empty-land problem: the terrain is full of traces, yet a blind heart experiences it as trackless and the traveler, not the ruins, becomes the one who fails to hear or see.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it assembles homonymous material branches into a water-drawing apparatus: qalb as well, ear as bodily or vessel handle, hearing hardware as a bucket handle, and breasts as departure from a watering place. It remains worth carrying because an explicitly disabled well is immediately adjacent and every component is packet-backed at a focus word; downstream prose must label it a latent material analogy, not claim that the focus nouns denote well equipment.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: بئر معطلة ... قلوب يعقلون بها أو آذان يسمعون بها ... القلوب التي في الصدور

activation_trace.role: The literal excavated well supplies the immediately adjacent material system.
Emptiness and disabling make the system's failure one of nonoperation rather than nonexistence.
The qalib as an unlined well turns the repeated hearts into latent inner receptacles within the analogy.
The bodily ear together with ear-like vessel handles supplies an intake or grasping fitting.
The bucket's handle, side, or crosspiece supplies concrete lifting and balancing hardware for drawing what the receptacle holds.
Departure from a watering place supplies the completion of the water-access cycle and links it to the repeated breast location.

changed_reading.before: The abandoned well is one external ruin, while hearts and ears are ordinary faculties in the next verse.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material resonance, the idle well primes cognition as an existing but unused drawing system: an inner well may hold evidence, yet its intake and lifting hardware do not bring that evidence into operative understanding.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the cognitive surface يعقلون activates the concrete camel-tether branch precisely in a surah scene of prepared lean mounts crossing deep passes. It remains anchored to the focus عقل and to branch-backed travel material; downstream prose should qualify tethering as an embodied analogy for disciplined inference, not substitute it for the ordinary sense 'reason.'

activation_trace.role: Binding a camel with a tether supplies the concrete act of restraining a mobile force.
Lightness after preparation supplies the trained moving mount that makes tethering situationally vivid.
The open mountain pass supplies the route along which disciplined mobility must be maintained.
The heart's capacity to turn supplies the mobile cognitive force that requires disciplined harnessing.

changed_reading.before: Reason is an abstract faculty applied after travel.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, reason is the tethering operation within travel: it harnesses the heart's rapid turns so observations arrive together at a directed conclusion.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it lets the causative exile branch of سير color an active plural form normally read as voluntary travel. It remains contextually live beside expulsion from homes and migration from one abode to another; downstream prose must present involuntary mobility as a secondary social expansion of the journey, not as morphology demanded by يسيروا.

activation_trace.role: Removal and exile supply a nonvoluntary edge of the travel inventory.
Passing out to the exterior supplies the contextual expulsion movement.
Belonging to or residing in a home supplies the stable place from which the people are removed.
Departure from one abode to another supplies a later explicit migration trajectory.

changed_reading.before: The focus imagines voluntary observers touring foreign remains.
changed_reading.after: A contained social reading also hears knowledge produced by forced or costly displacement: those made to move through the land may encounter histories and vulnerabilities hidden from settled observers.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the fortress/refuge branch of عقل is activated by a surviving fortified building while the verse uses عقل cognitively. It remains anchored in the exact focus root and immediate architectural contrast; downstream prose should frame outer versus inner fortification as an analogy, not identify the palace with a specific historical referent.

activation_trace.role: A ma'qil as fortress and refuge supplies an interior protective structure latent in the reasoning root.
The enclosed building supplies visible outer confinement and protection.
Raised and strengthened construction supplies the maximum external fortification in the ruin scene.
Emptiness supplies the failure of strong architecture to preserve the communal life around it.
The heart as understanding locates the alternative refuge inwardly.

changed_reading.before: The fortified palace is simply another impressive ruin.
changed_reading.after: As an architectural analogy, the surviving outer fortress exposes the need for an inner ma'qil: construction can remain elevated while the reasoning refuge that preserves communal orientation is absent.

strongest_changes: Travel became a disciplined evidentiary practice that reconstructs absent societies from material residues and reasons across delayed outcomes.
The heart shifted from a static container to a turnable, affective, error-correcting source of orientation and action.
Hearing shifted from acoustic receipt to accepting calls, integrating testimony, correcting noisy transmission, and running relational parables.
The later living-world scenes preserved a coexisting process reading based on inputs, transitions, restraints, and counterfactuals.
The immediately disabled well activated a contained but unusually coherent material analogy among heart, ear, hearing hardware, and watering-place departure.
summary.what_was_special: The focus supports several simultaneous epistemologies rather than one final gloss: mobile observation, narrated history, ritual-affective response, temporal patience, signal discrimination, and analogical testing. Immediate ruin imagery also activates branch-distant material mechanics that a conservative synthesis would likely erase.
remaining_uncertainties: The disabled-well apparatus may be a productive packet-backed resonance rather than an intentionally coordinated lexical network.
The causative exile branch of سير is morphologically distant from active يسيروا and should remain secondary.
The error-correction sequence in 22:52-54 may be specific to prophetic transmission rather than a general model of all hearing.
The process-field reading of 22:63-65 depends on a reader-supplied causal arrow between ordered signs, though the packet explicitly supplies their sequence and constraints.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Travel should tether perception to consequence.** `س ي ر B001/B002` is forward travel and conduct; `ع ق ل B001/B002` understanding as restraint and tethering; `ء ذ ن B002` receptive hearing; `س م ع B003` comprehension and compliance. Walking through ruined settlements supplies sensory evidence. I infer that reasoning binds visible traces to moral causes so the traveler does not repeat them. Hearts formed by travel therefore read as restraining faculties, not repositories of information.
2. **The real blindness is a reversal in the issuing center.** `ب ص ر B001/B002` separates eyesight from inner sight; `ع م ي B001/B002` distinguishes ocular and heart-blindness; `ق ل ب B001/B004` is inward faculty and reversal; `ص د ر B001/B004` chest and source from which things issue. Explicit negation transfers blindness from eyes to hearts in chests. I infer that evidence arrives but is reversed or blocked at the source of response. The verse diagnoses failed interpretation, not lack of visual data.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 22:70 answered the question of adequate cognition with a joined record spanning sky and earth, contrasting comprehensive inscription with heart-blind travel.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Travel is an input to an epistemic restraint circuit.** Fixed `يَسِيرُوا` activates `س ي ر:B001` (going forward), the route passes through `ء ر ض:B001`, and its intended result is `ق ل ب:B001` (inward faculty) performing `ع ق ل:B001` (understanding as restraint from ignorance). Ears add `س م ع:B001` (hearing) with possible `B003` (understanding and compliance). `22:45` supplies visible ruins and `22:47-48` supply the mistaken inference drawn from delay. The packet supplies movement, traces, reception, and restraint; I infer that travel should convert external evidence into a check on judgment. The ayah does not commend motion as tourism but as disciplined inference.
2. **Working eyes can coexist with a blinded interpretive center.** Fixed `تَعْمَى` distinguishes `ع م ي:B001` (loss of eyesight) from `B002` (blindness of heart), while `ٱلْأَبْصَار` permits `ب ص ر:B001` (ocular sight) and `B002` (inner sight); the hearts are explicitly located in `ص د ر:B001` (bodily chest). The packet supplies intact sensation and failed inward processing. I infer that evidence can arrive without producing insight. Blindness is relocated from organ failure to relation-making failure.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: `22:47-48` reveal the specific blindness at issue: visible delay is interpreted as failed promise even though the same historical sequence ends in taking. The heart fails to relate evidence across time.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iki belirli yapıda ortak bir ayırıp uzaklaştırma yönü verir: hayvanın sırt örtüsünü üzerinden çıkarma ve kişiyi ülkesinden çıkarıp uzaklaştırma. Dal çerçevesi bu iki yapıya bağlı anlamı doğru biçimde korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam genel hareket değildir; yalnızca belirtilen yapılarda bir örtüyü üzerinden alma veya kişiyi ülkesinden çıkarma eylemidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnızca hayvanın sırt örtüsünü çıkarma ve kişiyi ülkesinden uzaklaştırma yapıları için geçerlidir; yalın kök anlamına genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Belirli yapılarda, hayvanın sırtındaki örtüyü çıkarıp atmak veya bir kişiyi ülkesinden çıkararak uzaklaştırmaktır.

facets.statement: Ortak yön, bir şeyi bağlı olduğu yüzeyden ya da bir kişiyi bulunduğu yerden ayırıp uzaklaştırmaktır.
Bir yapıda hayvanın sırt örtüsü sırtından çıkarılır veya atılır.
Başka bir yapıda kişi ülkesinden çıkarılır ve uzaklaştırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların toplu anlatımı, iki belirli yapıda yerinden ayırıp uzaklaştırma ortaklığını gösterir: sırt örtüsünün çıkarılması ve kişinin ülkesinden uzaklaştırılması.

concept_gloss.text: örtüyü üzerinden almak ya da kişiyi yurdundan çıkarmak
concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın iki ayrı yapıya bağlı gerçekleşmesini ve her yapıdaki katılanları açıkça koruyan karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Örtü ile hayvan ve kişi ile ülke arasındaki iki ayrı uzaklaştırma ilişkisini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir hayvanın sırtındaki örtünün alınıp atıldığı yapı için doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Örtünün hayvanın sırtından ayrılması eylemini korur.
error_profile.loses: Bir kişinin ülkesinden çıkarılması anlamını kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin ülkesinden zorla çıkarılıp uzaklaştırıldığı yapı için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Kişiyi ülkesinden çıkarıp uzaklaştırma eylemini korur.
error_profile.loses: Hayvanın sırt örtüsünü çıkarma anlamını kapsamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal, hayvanın sırt örtüsünü çıkarma yapısını da içerir ve kişi için ülke sınırını belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, kişi veya şeyi genel olarak kovma, dışlama ve uzaklaştırma alanını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da bir kişi bulunduğu çevreden çıkarılıp uzaklaştırılabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal iki belirli yapıyla sınırlıdır; komşu dal ise nesne ve yer bakımından daha genel bir kovma ve uzaklaştırma anlamı taşır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal, kişinin ülkesinden çıkarılmasını ve hayvan örtüsünün alınmasını özel olarak belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, yapı, elde tutulan şey ve başka nesneler dahil daha geniş bir yerinden söküp alma alanına sahiptir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: özel yapıdaki çıkarma ile genel yerinden sökme
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da bir nesne bağlı veya bulunduğu yerden ayrılır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın katılanları ve yapıları sabittir; komşu dal farklı nesnelerin el, rüzgar veya başka bir güçle yerinden alınmasını anlatır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; seçilen komşular, yapıların özgül katılanlarını genel kovma ve genel yerinden sökme anlamlarından ayırır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi anlamı yolculuk eden topluluk ve yolcu kafilesi olarak açıkça verir. Dal çerçevesi topluluğu hareket eyleminin kendisinden ayırdığı için kaynak sınırına uygundur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal yol alma eylemini değil, birlikte yol alan insanlardan oluşan topluluğu adlandırır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın sözcüğün yolculuk eden topluluk anlamıyla sınırlıdır; tek yolcuya, taşıta veya hareket eylemine genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Birlikte yol alan insanlardan oluşan yolcu topluluğu veya kafiledir.

facets.statement: Gönderge, tek kişi değil birlikte yol alan bir insan topluluğudur.
Topluluk düzenli bir yolcu kafilesi olarak düşünülebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar sözcüğü birlikte yol alan insan topluluğu olarak tanımlar ve bunu yolcu kafilesiyle açıklar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Birlikte hareket eden insan grubunu, eylem veya taşıt anlamı eklemeden karşılayan genel ifadedir.

error_profile.preserves: Birlikte yol alma ve bir topluluk oluşturma özelliklerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yolculuk eden topluluğun düzenli ve birlikte hareket eden bir grup olduğu bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yolculuk eden insanların birlikte oluşturduğu topluluk anlamını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal, birlikte yol alan topluluğu bir bütün ve yolcu kafilesi olarak adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, yol arkadaşlığı ve aynı yolculuktaki eşlik bağını özellikle öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da birlikte yolculuk eden insan grubunu gösterebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal grubun topluluk kimliğini adlandırır; komşu dal aynı gruptaki eşlik ve arkadaşlık ilişkisini daha belirgin taşır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dalda taşınan yük veya yolculuğun amacı belirtilmeden yolcu topluluğu anlatılır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, yiyecek yükü taşıyan insanları, develeri ve yükleri özel olarak kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: yolcu topluluğu ile azık taşıyan kafile
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da yol üzerinde birlikte hareket eden bir grup görünümünde buluşabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı kuran özellik toplu yolculuktur; komşu dalı kuran özellik ise yiyecek yükünün taşınmasıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; yolcu topluluğunu yol arkadaşlığı ilişkisinden ve yük taşıma amacıyla tanımlanan gruptan ayıran iki karşılaştırma seçildi.
